title: A member's progress summary is stored again after they leave the gym
what: When a member leaves, their trainer summary is deleted at once. But the three ways the phone sends a summary never check whether the member has left, so the next send from an app that still has sharing on stores the summary again. Nobody at the gym can see it (the lists skip members who left), but it stays on the server until a trainer list is read 90 days later, against the privacy notice's promise that it is deleted on leaving. The gym mate sharing, by contrast, refuses a member who left.
expected: A send from a member who left is refused, and nothing is stored.
who: members who leave a gym with sharing still on
how_often: every time such an app sends after leaving
fix_line: Refuse the summary send for a member who has left, as the gym mate sharing does

title: In a paused gym a member cannot take back a request or clear an answer
what: While the gym is paused, the guard on the pause and renew requests also blocks deleting and updating them. Taking back a waiting request or marking an answer as seen then fails with an error, though the member side promises never to raise an error after the key check, and the other new tables allow deleting in a paused gym.
expected: Taking back a request and marking an answer as seen keep working in a paused gym; only new requests and decisions stop.
how_often: only while a gym is paused
fix_line: Let the pause guard allow deletes and the seen mark
